name: fitzone-gim-gestion
description: FITZONE - Sistema de Gestion Integral para Gimnasio (React 18 + Express + SQLite + Baileys + IA)

scripts.build: npm install --include=dev --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npm install --include=dev --prefix server && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --prefix server && npm run lint:fix --prefix client
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
